source_cost: Iowa State Univ. Ext. A3-10 '2026 Iowa Farm Custom Rate Survey' p.2 (drilling cover crop seed); seed price snapshot Aug 2026; IDALS Cover Crop Cost-Share Program 2026 (iowaagriculture.gov news, 7 Jul 2026)
notes: Filled 2026-11-14. COST = drilling $19.05 (2026 custom rate survey average; median 19.25, range 9-25, 39 responses) + seed 50 lb x $0.25/lb = $12.50 (NRCS Iowa cereal rye fact sheet: 45 lb/acre PLS drilled; cost-share minimum 45 lb; Iowa seed listings $0.235-0.42/lb). Termination assumed in the normal burndown (no extra pass). Cross-check: Iowa State survey medians of total added cover-crop cost were $34-35/acre. COSTSHARE = $20/acre, the 2026 IDALS rate for returning users (first-time $30; up to 160 acres; Greater Des Moines watershed counties $25 on up to 500 acres). Practical Farmers of Iowa pays a separate $15/acre (not counted). The seed price is a market snapshot, not an official series (verify)
